Name: Weapon (Carving)
Description: Standard weapons made from wood, bone, or similar worked materials.

Name: Weapon (Smithing)
Description: Standard weapons forged from metal.

Name: Armor - Light (Carving)
Description: Light armor built from wood or bone reinforcement.

Name: Armor - Light (Tailoring)
Description: Light armor sewn from cloth and leather.

Name: Armor - Light (Smithing)
Description: Light armor with metal fittings and plating.

Name: Armor - Heavy (Smithing)
Description: Heavy armor. Can only be made using Smithing.

Name: Armor - Medium (Tailoring)
Description: Medium armor built from reinforced leather.

Name: Armor - Medium (Smithing)
Description: Medium armor with substantial metal components — mail or plated leather.

Name: Armor - Medium (Upgrade from Light, Tailoring)
Description: Reinforce an existing suit of Light Armor into Medium with added leather and padding, instead of building fresh.

Name: Armor - Medium (Upgrade from Light, Smithing)
Description: Reinforce an existing suit of Light Armor into Medium with added metal plating, instead of building fresh.

Name: Armor - Heavy (Upgrade from Medium)
Description: Reinforce an existing suit of Medium Armor into Heavy with additional plating. Can only be made using Smithing, same as building Heavy fresh.

Name: Armor - Heavy (Upgrade from Light)
Description: Reinforce an existing suit of Light Armor directly into Heavy. Can only be made using Smithing, same as building Heavy fresh.

Name: Unarmed Enhancer (Tailoring)
Description: Generally a base item for Masterwork items, for unarmed attacks.

Name: Unarmed Enhancer (Smithing)
Description: Generally a base item for Masterwork items, for unarmed attacks.

Name: Basic Clothing
Description: For any applicable slot.

Name: Basic Jewelry
Description: For any applicable slot.

Name: Adventurer's Kit
Description: A general collection of useful travel gear — mess kit, bedroll, waterskin, knife, rope, and a tinderbox.

Name: Knapsack
Description: A small traveler's pack worn across the back.

Name: Backpack
Description: A decent-sized bag with two sturdy straps and some outside pockets.

Name: Rucksack
Description: A large bag with multiple sections and pockets.

Name: Survivalist's Pack
Description: A great pack with multiple reinforced straps.

Name: Adventurer's Belt
Description: A sturdy belt with pouches for easy access to tools.

Name: Cart (Small)
Description: A small wooden cart with long handles.

Name: Cart (Medium)
Description: A more substantial wooden cart reinforced with metal.

Name: Wagon (Large)
Description: A great wooden wagon bound with bands of iron.

Name: Musical Instrument
Description: Lutes, trumpets, drums, and the like — whichever material fits the specific instrument.

Name: Climber's Kit
Description: Hooks, pitons, boot spikes, and other climbing gear.

Name: Disguise Kit
Description: Basic cosmetics and a variety of costume accessories.

Name: Tinker's Kit
Description: Picks, screwdrivers, pins, and the like, wrought from fine spring steel.

Name: Mixology Set
Description: Beakers, spoons, vials, and other measuring devices.

Name: Tailor's Kit
Description: A satchel of needles, shears, and other tools of the trade — same tools-are-metal logic as every other Craft kit.

Name: Carving Kit
Description: A satchel of knives, chisels, and other tools of the trade.

Name: Smithing Kit
Description: A satchel of hammers, tongs, and other tools of the trade.

Name: Jeweler's Kit
Description: A satchel of fine files, tongs, and other tools of the trade.

Name: Fisher's Kit
Description: A rod, hooks, and the other basics of tackle.

Name: Other Items
Description: For various skill kits, adventuring goods, and other items that a character might want to create. Too variable to auto-match against a character's build — reference only, use whichever School/Skill Total fits the specific item.

Name: Medicinal Supply
Description: Used in place of cards for certain Medicine-related Techniques and similar uses.

Name: Alcohol
Description: Fermented and distilled drinks — priced and crafted as a simple reagent rather than a proper Potion, since Alcohol has no effect purely on its own. Just one material of its own Level, same as its Gold cost.

Name: Basic Conveniences
Description: Soap, dyes, lubricants, wax, and similar everyday goods needing no particular recipe of their own.

Name: Charcoal
Description: Purified charcoal from a woodfire.

Name: Incense
Description: Bricks of incense that burn for a few hours.

Name: Oil
Description: A small flask of oil rendered pure enough to burn.

Name: Embalming Fluid
Description: A preservative fluid for organic matter.

Name: Quicktorch
Description: A wooden stick with a specially prepared, alchemically-treated head.

Name: Recreational Drugs
Description: Doses of a recreational drug — refined to whatever degree its own quality implies.

Name: Alchemical Potion
Description: Generic fallback for Potions without their own specific recipe — beneficial brews and elixirs. Each Potion's own entry states its Main Type.

Name: Alchemical Poison
Description: Generic fallback for Poisons without their own specific recipe — harmful concoctions and venoms. Each Poison's own entry states its Main Type.

Name: Alchemical Grenade
Description: Generic fallback for Grenades without their own specific recipe — thrown one-use alchemical devices. Each Grenade's own entry states its Main Type.

Name: Food Item
Description: Generic fallback for Food without their own specific recipe — prepared meals and preserved rations.
Skill Total: Mixology or Survival [twice the item's Level]

Name: Masterwork Enhancement
Description: Generic fallback for Masterwork items without their own specific recipe. School varies per power — check the item's own text (same as base item, unless otherwise stated). Each Masterwork item's entry states its own Main Type; its Optional Type comes from whichever base item is chosen (see the rulebook's "base item" rules).
